description: Position Title: Produce Clerk - Full Time Position Type: Full time Job Requisition ID: 49560 Banner: Food Basics Employment Type: Permanent This position is part of a unionized bargaining unit. The hourly wage for this position starts at $18.00 - $21.35 and is established in accordance with the collective agreement. Depending on a candidateâs relevant knowledge, skills, education, and prior experience, a higher hourly wage may be offered. Any hourly wage offered for this role, whether starting or higher, will fall within the wage scale established for this position in accordance with the collective agreement. This is a posting for an existing permanent full-time position Experience a rewarding role at Food Basics as a Produce Clerk! You'll be the go-to person for ensuring our produce section is always fresh, well-stocked, and beautifully presented. Share your enthusiasm for fresh fruits and vegetables with our customers and help them find exactly what they need. Our produce team is crucial to Food Basics' success, and we're looking for energetic individuals who love working with fresh food and enjoy helping others. If you thrive in a lively environment and are passionate about quality produce, we want you on our team! What Youâll Do Unload shipments of produce and sort items in the backroom and cooler. Stock shelves and displays with fresh produce, ensuring items are rotated (first-in, first-out method) to maintain freshness. Create visually appealing displays and arrange items neatly. Inspect produce for freshness and quality, removing any damaged or spoiled items. Ensure that all produce meets the store's quality standards. Monitor temperature and humidity levels in the produce section to maintain optimal storage conditions. Assist customers with locating specific items and provide information about different produce or products in other departments. Offer recommendations on how to select and store produce. Answer customer inquiries and address concerns. Keep the produce section clean and organized, including sweeping and mopping as needed. Clean and sanitize work areas, equipment, and tools regularly. Dispose of waste and compostable materials properly. Monitor inventory levels and restock items as needed. Perform regular inventory counts and report any discrepancies. Notify management of low stock or out-of-stock items. Ensure all produce is correctly labeled with prices and product information. Update signage for promotions, sales, and seasonal items. Verify that prices in the system match the displayed prices. Reduce and price items as needed. Adhere to food safety and sanitation guidelines. Use equipment and tools safely and properly. Report any safety concerns or incidents to management. Assist with gathering shopping carts or baskets and putting them away when needed. Assist with special promotions, events, or projects as assigned by management. Collaborate with other departments as needed. Additional duties assigned by Management. Qualifications Customer service driven. Able to stock merchandise and create displays. Good product knowledge and attention to detail. Able to lift between 30 to 50 pounds. Retail experience is considered an asset. Able to stand for extend periods of time. Must be available to work flexible shifts which may include nights, weekends and holidays. title: Construction Estimator
description: Estimator We are seeking a detail-orientated and analytical Estimator with a passion for construction to join our team. Overview Working alongside the Senior Estimator, the ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing detailed and accurate cost estimates for a wide variety of commercial construction projects. Candidates must have a building background with extensive knowledge of all aspects of refurbishment and commercial construction across numerous sectors. This role requires a strong understanding of cost control and the ability to communicate effectively with various stakeholders. The Estimator will work closely with project managers, engineers and other sub-contractors, and play a crucial role in ensuring our bids are technically accurate, timely and competitive. Min 3 years experience in an estimating role. Full driving licence and the ability to travel when required is essential. Duties Prepare detailed cost estimates for projects, including materials, subcontractors, labour and pre - lims from tenders, drawings and client briefs. title: Wireperson
description: Description Trant Te-Tech design, custom build and install a wide range of high quality control panels, motor control centres (MCCs) and automation systems, offering conventional, intelligent and withdrawable systems with outstanding reliability and functionality. We are currently looking for a proven Wireperson to join our workshop based near Totton, Southampton. The Role The Wire Person is responsible for the accurate assembly and wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems in accordance with electrical drawings, specifications, and applicable standards. The role plays a key part in ensuring assemblies meet quality, safety, and compliance requirements prior to inspection and testing. What Youll Be Doing Technical Responsibilities - Panel & MCC Wiring Carry out wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems to approved schematics and wiring diagrams. Install and terminate power, control, and instrumentation cabling. Assemble and wire MCCs and control panels. Ensure correct segregation, routing and termination in line with design and compliance requirements. Technical Support & Collaboration Accurately interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and general arrangement drawings. Mark up drawings where required to reflect as-built changes. Follow work instructions and build documentation. Work collaboratively with fellow wire-people, testers, and supervisors to meet production targets. Support improvements in wiring practices, layout, and efficiency. Provide feedback to supervisors on build issues or potential improvements. SHE&Q and Compliance Carry out self-checks and peer checks prior to formal testing. Identify and report defects, non-conformances or drawing discrepancies. Work safely in accordance with company H&S procedures and UK legislation. Maintain a clean, tidy and organised working area. Use tools, equipment, and PPE correctly at all times. Key Interfaces: Internal Interfaces Workshop Supervisor. Production Manager. Test Engineer. Design & Engineering Teams. Automation Team. Stores / Logistic. Quality Team. External Interfaces Clients / Inspectors (as required) Suppliers (limited) Core Values Uphold and promote the Companys Core Values Care, Trust, Respect and Sustainability. What Were Looking For Essential NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in Electrical Installation, Panel Wiring, or Electrical Engineering. Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and GA drawings. Working knowledge of electrical safety practices and workshop H&S requirements. Familiarity with quality-controlled manufacturing processes. Proven experience wiring control panels, MCCs, or similar electrical assemblies. Experience terminating power, control, and instrumentation wiring. Experience working from schematics, wiring schedules, and BOMs. Experience completing work to high quality and safety standards in a workshop environment. Applicants must be legally authorised to work in the UK, as we are unable to sponsor work visas for this role. Desirable 18th Edition (BS 7671) qualification. Awareness or training relating to BS EN 61439-2:2021. Manufacturer or industry training on MCCs, switchgear andautomation systems. First Aid or IOSH Working Safely certification. Experience wiring MCCs and control panels. Experience with PLC I/O wiring, automation panels, and instrumentation. Experience supporting test and inspection activities, including rectification of faults. Experience working on custom-built, client-specific panel builds. Why Join Trant ? At Trant Engineering, we deliver complex, high-value engineering and construction projects across the UK. From process and water treatment to energy infrastructure upgrades, we play a key role in delivering and protecting critical national infrastructure shaping the systems that communities and industries rely on every day. Our teams design and deliver full EPC solutions, combining technical excellence with practical, hands-on delivery. We offer end-to-end capabilities from concept and design through to manufacturing, construction and commissioning utilising a continually evolving in-house expertise. This means youll work on projects that are varied, challenging and genuinely impactful. Our multi-disciplinary teams bring together specialists in civil, mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, and control & automation engineering, alongside our in-house manufacturing of control panels, MCCs, PLCs and SCADA systems. With over 1,000 people and a strong, growing pipeline of work, its an exciting time to join Trant. We are committed to helping our people succeed through our Career Development Association, providing structured support, mentoring and clear pathways to help you reach your full potential. Whether youre starting out or looking to take your next career step, Trant offers the chance to develop, progress and make a real difference. Our company benefits package includes: Competitive rates. 28 days holiday (including bank holidays). Options to buy additional holiday via salary sacrifice. Company pension scheme. Employee assistance program. Discretionary annual bonus. Join us and be part of something bigger. Introduction:

About The Company

Acumentis is Australia's only independent ASX-listed property valuation and advisory firm. With 350+ team members across 45 locations, we combine national scale with local support and a strong focus on service, inclusion and professional development.

Description:

About The Role

As a Residential Valuer, you will be a key member of our team, collaborating with fellow Valuers and Directors to achieve Acumentis' business objectives and regional goals. Your responsibilities will include:

  • High-Quality Valuations: Deliver valuations of the highest quality, adhering to client and company guidelines, and meeting required service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Market Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of sales trends and market conditions to inform valuation practices.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, contributing to business development initiatives.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Report regularly to the Regional Director and work closely to achieve targeted outcomes.


This position is also open to an Associate Director or Director role for the right candidate.

Skills and Experiences:

About You

Youâll be a great fit for us if:

  • You have a minimum 2 year's relevant experience in residential valuations
  • You possess tertiary qualifications in a relevant Property Degree
  • You have a Certified Practising Valuer (CPV) Qualification
  • You have strong working knowledge of the residential property market in Port Macquarie and surrounding areas.
  • You have a great ability to create and maintain working relationships with clients and colleagues


Weâll be a great fit for you if:

  • Youâd like an extra day of leave for your birthday, study or volunteer opportunities
  • Youâd like to take advantage of employee benefits such as bank partnerships, employee discounts and a full wellness calendar of activities - with new benefits added each month!
  • Youâre looking to join a business with a strong national presence, where relocation can be supported
  • Youâd like a position with a strong client base and steady stream of work
  • Youâd like to ensure your life/work balance through flexible work arrangements
  • Youâd like mentoring from industry leaders to guide your career, and create a guaranteed pathway for our twice-yearly promotion program


It is a condition of employment that staff are to obtain National Police Clearance (paid for by the business).

If working with Acumentis in this period of growth sounds like something you are looking for, please apply online via the link provided. If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact the People Team (people@acumentis.com.au). We are unable to consider emailed applications.

SALARY: CI$50,000 - CI$70,000 pa


WORKING HOURS: 40 HOURS PER WEEK


TERM OF EMPLOYMENT: Full-Time


We are seeking a Building Maintenance Technician to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of building infrastructure and systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation of facilities.


DO YOU HAVE:


A high school diploma (or equivalent) and a valid trade license

A minimum of 5 yearsâ experience in building maintenance within Class A Commercial properties

Strong HVAC experience in chilled water and DX systems

Training and certification in electrical, plumbing, HVAC systems maintenance, Pool Operator and Man Lift operation

A valid Cayman Islands driverâs license

The ability to operate hand and power tools required, in a safe and efficient manner

Strong knowledge of building, electrical, plumbing and MEP systems, including related equipment, tools, hazards and safety precautions

Strong communication, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills

The ability to perform physically demanding manual work for extended periods in varying and sometimes adverse conditions is required, including working in inclement weather and with regular exposure to dust and noise, as well as heavy lifting, prolonged standing, and climbing

Support contractor coordination, disaster preparedness, and recovery activities

Communicate effectively, work collaboratively, promote a safe customer-focused environment, and demonstrate professionalism and sound judgment

At Dart, we're committed to creating a workplace where you thrive, offering a competitive salary and benefits designed for your well-being and growth. title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.   Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.   PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada. Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities. You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game. 
 Responsibilities Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability Requirements A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities Pluses Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration 
 $115,000 - $149,500 a year

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.
